About the Role

We are looking for a data scientist intern to join our Data Science team at GoPay - you will create models which help grow the customer base and transactions in GoPay. You will work closely with the business, product and engineering stakeholders to identify and solve some of the most challenging business problems in the payments space. You will have the opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment in a highly cross-functional team and leverage our robust data infrastructure

About the Team

GoPay Data Science team builds critical ML components/models which go into the engineering systems which make GoPay a safe, trusted and fun way to do payments. Our team members come from varied backgrounds, and bring with them a wide set of skills (mathematics, statistics, machine learning, deep learning etc.) which we use some of the toughest business problems in GoPay. We are enthusiastic about both data science techniques and methods, as well as the business impact of our models, and have numerous internal forums where sharing, discussions and presentations by the team members happen.

What You Will Do

• Work as part of a cross-functional team of engineers, product managers and business analysts to build data science solutions that build customer engagement and help grow GoPay’s customer base and transactions
• Rapidly prototype data science solutions and be involved in product and feature discussions
• Analyze large volume data and generate insights which will be actionable
• Own end-to-end solutioning, from formulating the technical problem to deployment (along with engineers) of the solution
• Participate in internal and external conferences and workshops

What You Will Need

• Fresh Graduates from computer science, mathematics, or statistics (Students on final semester are also preferred)
• Strong quantitative and problem-solving skills
• Solid understanding of Statistics/ML fundamentals and demonstrated experience in Python, R
• Communication skills to engage with business stakeholders to understand their needs and effectively communicate the results of the analytical solutions
• Ability to write clear and concise technical documentation
• Experience in recommender system, ranking, multi-armed bandits, search and discovery is a plus

Job Summary:**

The COORDINATOR SH NGANJUK will be responsible for overseeing and managing all safety, health, and environmental (SH) programs and initiatives within the Nganjuk facility, ensuring compliance with company policies and relevant regulations.

Job Responsibilities:**

* Develop, implement, and monitor SH programs, policies, and procedures in line with PT Japfa Food Indonesia's standards and local regulations.
* Conduct regular risk assessments and safety audits to identify potential hazards and implement corrective actions.
* Investigate all incidents, accidents, and near misses, determining root causes and developing preventative measures.
* Provide SH training to employees at all levels, including new hire orientation and ongoing refresher courses.
* Ensure the facility maintains all necessary SH permits and licenses.
* Prepare and submit regular SH reports to management, highlighting key performance indicators and areas for improvement.
* Lead and participate in SH committees and initiatives to foster a strong safety culture.
* Manage the procurement and maintenance of personal protective equipment (PPE) and other safety-related equipment.
* Liaise with external regulatory bodies and ensure compliance with all environmental protection standards.
* Champion continuous improvement in SH performance across the Nganjuk facility.

Job Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health and Safety, Environmental Engineering, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in a Safety, Health, and Environmental (SH) role, preferably within the manufacturing or food processing industry.
* Certified expertise in relevant SH regulations (e.g., AK3 Umum, K3).
* Strong understanding of risk assessment methodologies and incident investigation techniques.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Willingness to be based in Nganjuk, Indonesia.




JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

Job Title: Laboratory Analyst

Department: Quality Control / Laboratory

Location: Feed Tangerang

Key Responsibilities

1. Laboratory Analysis

• Perform and prepare raw material and animal feed analyses in accordance with established testing methods and laboratory standards.
• Conduct laboratory testing for the following parameters: MoistureProteinFatFiberCalciumSodiumRing TestReference Test
• Store and manage raw material samples in accordance with applicable procedures.
• Ensure analysis results are accurate, valid, and completed within the established turnaround time.
• Prepare and report laboratory analysis results accurately and in a timely manner.

2. Laboratory Safety & Housekeeping

• Implement 5S practices (Seiri, Seiton, Seiso, Seiketsu, and Shitsuke) within the laboratory area.
• Comply with and enforce Occupational Health and Safety (OHS/K3) standards and regulations.
• Maintain cleanliness, organization, safety, and a comfortable working environment in the laboratory.
• Participate in accident prevention initiatives and identify potential workplace hazards.

3. Inventory Management

• Manage inventories of chemical reagents, consumables, and laboratory equipment.
• Monitor stock availability to ensure uninterrupted laboratory testing activities and NIR operations.
• Maintain inventory records and prepare periodic inventory reports.
• Ensure efficient and proper utilization of laboratory materials and equipment in accordance with procedures.

4. Documentation & Data Management

• Ensure the availability, completeness, and accuracy of laboratory documents and records.
• Maintain the confidentiality of laboratory data and analysis results.
• Ensure all Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and supporting documents are updated as required.
• Organize and maintain laboratory data and documentation systematically for easy retrieval and traceability.

5. Coordination & Communication

• Coordinate with relevant departments to support quality control activities.
• Maintain effective working relationships with colleagues, supervisors, subordinates, and other stakeholders.
• Uphold the company’s positive image through compliance with applicable policies, procedures, and regulations.

6. Continuous Improvement

• Enhance professional competencies through relevant learning and training activities.
• Provide recommendations and actively participate in continuous improvement initiatives to increase laboratory efficiency and effectiveness.
• Support the implementation of quality
• improvement and productivity enhancement programs.

7. Other Assigned Duties

• Perform other duties assigned by the supervisor within the scope of the position and operational requirements of the company.
